description: Source implementation of CurrencyDataLoader class for currency data fetching, caching, and processing in a Windows app. Handles cache management, web requests, parsing JSON responses, and unit setup for currency conversion.

classes.name: CurrencyDataLoader
classes.description: Handles loading, caching, and parsing of currency data for currency conversion in a Windows app.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the loader with optional forced language.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::~CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up network event subscriptions.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::LoadData
methods.description: Main method to load currency data, tries cache first then web.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetOrderedCategories
methods.description: Returns categories; not used directly, returns empty.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetOrderedUnits
methods.description: Returns list of currency units.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::SupportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if category is currency category.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for UI updates.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetCurrencySymbols
methods.description: Returns symbols for two currency units.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::RoundCurrencyRatio
methods.description: Rounds ratio to display meaningful digits.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetCurrencyRatioEquality
methods.description: Returns string representations of ratio between two units.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::TryLoadDataFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from cache asynchronously.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::TryFinishLoadFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Completes loading from cache if possible.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::TryLoadDataFromWebAsync
methods.description: Fetches data from web and caches it.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::TryLoadDataFromWebOverrideAsync
methods.description: Forces web load, bypassing cache.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::FinalizeUnits
methods.description: Finalizes currency units and ratios after data load.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GuaranteeSelectedUnits
methods.description: Ensures default units are selected.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::NotifyDataLoadFinished
methods.description: Notifies UI of load success or failure.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::SaveLangCodeAndTimestamp
methods.description: Saves language and timestamp to local settings.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::UpdateDisplayedTimestamp
methods.description: Updates UI with timestamp info.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetCurrencyTimestamp
methods.description: Returns formatted timestamp string.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::GetDefaultFromToCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves default 'from' and 'to' currencies, from cache or defaults.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::TryGetLastUsedCurrenciesFromLocalSettings
methods.description: Attempts to get last used currencies from local settings.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader::SaveSelectedUnitsToLocalSettings
methods.description: Saves selected units to local settings.
